g.title: E1cB dehydration event 1
g.desc: CH₃COCH₂C(OH)(CH₃)₂ + HO⁻ ⇌ CH₃COCH⁻C(OH)(CH₃)₂ + H₂O Second alpha deprotonation forms the E1cB precursor; no carbonyl bond is broken.

g.text: Second alpha deprotonation forms the E1cB precursor; no carbonyl bond is broken.
Original structural mechanism · 2-electron curved arrows · 2D depiction, not a calculated trajectory.

g.title: E1cB dehydration event 2
g.desc: CH₃COCH⁻C(OH)(CH₃)₂ → CH₃COCH=C(CH₃)₂ + HO⁻ Enolate C pair → alpha/beta C=C; beta C–O pair → O. Mesityl oxide has no E/Z at this alkene.
